name: Laser Beams
desc: Fans of thin laser beams firing from the top corners, sweeping and crossing with per-section patterns and treble-driven brightness, from saturated neon club lines to austere monochrome, prism rainbows, wide sheets and abstract dot-lattice scans.

style.doc: neon=saturated core+halo club lines / mono=austere desaturated single-hue / prism=rainbow fan / sheet=wide volumetric bands / grid=abstract dot-lattice scan

act.doc: fan=corner fans / cross=scissoring crossfire / scan=tight sweeping sheet
